Agent Keys are agent-tagged restricted API keys with approval-rule governance; key prefixes alone do not prove tagging, least privilege or transaction authority.

N-tier is an architecture style, not the definition of WAF. Logical layers and physical tiers need not map one-to-one; asynchronous messaging is supported.

Official announcement (publishedAt 2026-10-09T19:56:06.371Z); publishes draft Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) at personalagentprotocol.org (/.well-known/poppy.json) and announces 35 additional design partners including Visa, Mastercard, Adyen, PayPal, Venmo, Plaid, OpenAI, Cloudflare, Okta, 1Password, and Target. Explicitly positions Poppy as complementary to UCP.

Draft v1 operations extension for Poppy v0.1.
